releaseNotes:
1. GIS Measurement Tool: Complete Distance & Area measurement with geodesic path calculation, multi-segment midpoint labels, polygon area in m²/sq.ft/ha, and perimeter.
2. Voltage Marker Differentiation: Rectangular badges for 230kV towers and circular badges for 110kV towers.
3. Map In-Situ Verification: Added direct Verify/Edit action to crossing map callouts.
4. Clean Layer Manager: Streamlined Independent GIS Overlays.

previousStableRelease.releaseNotes:
1. Google Satellite & Google Hybrid: Replaced ESRI imagery with native Google Satellite (lyrs=s) and Google Hybrid (lyrs=y) high-resolution tiles.
2. Fix Black Screen & App Exit on Crossing Select: Removed redundant Navigator.pop in onSelectCrossingOnMap and enhanced PopScope so tapping Back dismisses crossing highlight.
3. Crossings Abstract Text Contrast: Changed 'Crossings Records' header from black87 to high-contrast white.
4. Zero-Regression Verification: 100% test pass on crossings module.
